title: Onboard aegir-13b v2.0 — perf profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Add aegir-13b v2.0 to the model registry with curated metadata, validated perf profiles for common sequence length distributions, and automated changelog/release-note generation. This PR bundles: 1) canonical metadata for aegir-13b v2.0 (authors, licenses, model config, tokenizer hints); 2) performance profiles generated from our benchmark-lab runs (latency, throughput, memory/kv-cache behavior across 1,2,4,8/16 token seqs); 3) small updates to the changelog automation pipeline so new model entries are appended to releases.md and a formatted release note is created when a model is marked ready. Checklist: - [x] Metadata schema validated (models/*/metadata.json) - [x] Perf profiles generated and sanity-checked against canary numbers - [x] Unit tests for metadata loader updated - [x] Changelog automation script added and integrated with CI - [x] Docs updated with model card entry - [x] Security review (license) done Migration notes: Existing model selection code is backwards-compatible; new fields is optional and defaulted. Changelog automation adds a single-line entry to releases.md when models are onboarded; it is gated behind a CI job so maintainers can review before merge. Testing: ran perf-smoke and full benchmark-lab suite for aegir-13b v2.0 on dedicated canary hosts; results attached. Release plan: after merge the model will be promoted to staging catalog and tagged aegir-13b:v2.0. The release note will be included in the next weekly model registry release. Related: ENG-2142 (onboarding sprint), PM-421 (catalog release planning).
